thread:
sam: quick q — for new tenant onboarding do we prefer operator-managed private endpoint (operator deploys a tiny agent in customer VPC) or an in-band regional proxy/relay (sidecarless relay inside our region)? thinking about control-plane separation, cert rotation, and rollback behavior.

ana: Operator endpoint pros: stronger isolation, customer controls egress, easier for compliance audits. Cons: heavier onboarding, more support surface, and ENI/NAT quotas in some clouds. :thinking_face:

priya: In-band relay pros: faster onboarding, single control-plane flow, easier to centralize metrics and billing. Cons: tougher to preserve source IP, and larger blast radius if the relay has a bug.

dev-bot: Deploy job queued: onboard-spike/operator-agent-v1 — CI will run connectivity tests and produce a small report when done.

mike: two operational questions: 1) cert rotation — operator model lets us rely on customer-managed keys for mTLS (nice for compliance). 2) fallback — if operator agent misbehaves, how do we failover to relay without customer disruption?

ana: fallback can be a routing policy from CP based on agent heartbeat. agent reports health; CP flips route to relay and attaches a header like `x-rw-fallback: operator-unhealthy`. UX/observability needs designing so support can explain why traffic went to hosted.

sam: rough flow: operator agent bootstraps with short-lived credential, registers endpoint in control plane; CP routes traffic to that endpoint. on health fail, CP marks tenant `fallback=true` and reroutes to regional relay. would like a TTL on fallback to auto-retry agent.

priya: small onboarding config example idea:
```
onboard:
  mode: operator
  bootstrap_token_ttl: 10m
  fallback_policy: auto
  fallback_ttl: 5m
```

mike: ops/finance note: operator model scatters egress IPs across customer accounts, making per-tenant NAT cost attribution harder. need an egress-accounting plan (tags, flow logs).

ana: agreed. tradeoff matrix summary we discussed: operator = better isolation/compliance, higher ops/support cost; relay = faster onboarding, simpler billing, larger central risk. propose spike: build minimal operator agent (no ENI juggling, just outbound TLS to CP), wire heartbeat + fallback, and measure onboarding time and support load.

sam: +1. action items: priya to spec agent bootstrap flow + token lifecycle, mike to define observability hooks and billing signals, ana to draft fallback header semantics and UX text. we'll reconvene after spike PR.

priya: taking bootstrap flow. ETA Wed.

sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
